top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes targeted protein degradation as a design principle: a bifunctional molecule drives a measurable ternary complex (cooperativity, linker dependence, Ciulli's VHL and ternary-complex structures) so that the cell removes a chosen protein, a capability that did not exist before. It was proposed by Crews and Deshaies, has been reproduced across many laboratories, ligases and targets, and a citation restricted to bifunctional degraders is accurate for these three names without claiming the molecular-glue strand. P003 follows because Handa's cereblon work is a real mechanistic discovery, but its broader citation spans two origins with three names; P002 is mature and cleanly credited but overlaps conceptually with the 2010 cross-coupling prize; no award is last because the evidence supports at least one sound prize.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; research on lipid self-assembly and amyloid is close to B049 and B047 but not to any candidate in these proposals, and Lund colleagues Linke and Somfai are a general connection only
